_comment: An agent's configuration. Copy to the platform's config directory and fill in:
A FILE ON THE BOX, NEVER SOMETHING A CALLER CAN CHANGE OVER THE WIRE. A remote caller drives what
this box already offers and nothing more.
control_plane  where the agent dials OUT to. Nothing connects to the box.
name           how this box appears in the fleet. One token per box, so one box can be revoked.
projects       each with its OWN checkout and its OWN engine binary. Never a checkout a CI runner
shares: a runner deletes and re-fetches its tools mid-job, which would remove the
engine from under a live measurement.
game_port      the band a job binds. Keep it clear of the ports a project's own CI harnesses use on
relay_port     the same machine, so a job here never makes an unrelated probe fail to bind.
job_retention  how many job directories to keep. Ids never repeat; the lowest are pruned at start.
lan            optional. The IPv4 address other machines join this box at. Set it on a box with more
than one network (Wi-Fi beside Ethernet, a VPN); without it the agent picks one.
name: win-gpu
